create_PinholeCameras: create a PinholeCameras module with n cameras using default intrinsics and extrinsics parameters
build_PinholeCameras_custom: build a PinholeCameras module with custom focal lengths fxs, fys, quaternions, and translations
run_PinholeCameras_forward: run the forward pass to project 2D pixel coordinates with depth into 3D world points
run_PinholeCameras_backproject: run the backproject method to convert 2D pixel coordinates and depth into camera space points
review_PinholeCameras_Rs: review the Rs property that computes rotation matrices from normalized quaternion parameters
